04331 Meysha' {may-shaw'}

源自 04185; 陰性專有名詞

AV - Mesha 1; 1

米沙 = "自由"
1) 一位便雅憫人, 沙哈連和他的妻子賀得在摩押地所生 (#代上8:9|)

04331 Meysha' {may-shaw'}

from 04185;; n pr m

AV - Mesha 1; 1

Mesha = "freedom"
1) a Benjamite, son of Shaharaim by his wife Hodesh who bore him in
   the land of Moab
